scientific_assumption: Older age should be associated with higher disability stage.
Grip strength should decrease as disability severity increases.
Physical activity should decrease as disability severity increases.
Depression burden should increase with disability severity.
Medication burden should increase with disability severity.
Poorer glycemic control should tend to increase with disability severity.
Systolic blood pressure should generally increase with disability burden.
BMI may increase with disability or show a non-linear/U-shaped relation.
